SwiftUI is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2020 to 2021.

What it was for: [Knowledge](@/projects/knowledge.md) (1) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [happ](@/work/happ.md): Playground App created during my Hospital Stay; [MinervaEye](@/work/minervaeye.md): iOS application for book management.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses SwiftUI: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links SwiftUI to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
